rounds.q: How many pounds does a gallon of whole milk weigh?
rounds.why: The exact figure is 8.6 pounds, so a single quart weighs just over 2 pounds.
rounds.src: USDA Agricultural Marketing Service, milk volume to weight conversion factors
rounds.fun: A gallon of milk is 8.6 pounds, and each quart is just over 2. Heavy sipping!

rounds.q: How many pounds does the average new car, SUV or pickup sold in the US weigh?
rounds.why: Take out electric and plug-in cars and the average drops by 72 pounds.
rounds.src: US EPA, Automotive Trends Report executive summary (model year 2024 data)
rounds.fun: The average new ride weighs 4,354 pounds. Plug-ins add 72 of them.

rounds.q: How many pounds does a newborn African elephant weigh?
rounds.why: Females start out near 210 pounds and males near 265. A grown one eats up to 300 pounds a day.
rounds.src: International Journal of Comparative Psychology (2013), African elephant calf study citing Poole 1996. National Geographic, African elephant facts
rounds.fun: A 235 pound baby! No wonder the grown-ups eat up to 300 pounds of food a day.

rounds.q: How many pounds does $1 million in $100 bills weigh?
rounds.why: Every US bill weighs about 1 gram, so a pound of cash is 454 bills.
rounds.src: US Currency Education Program (Federal Reserve), Currency Facts: 10,000 notes at 1 gram each
rounds.fun: A million dollars weighs just 22 pounds. Every bill is about 1 gram!

rounds.q: How many tons does an average puffy white cloud weigh?
rounds.why: That's about 1.1 million pounds, for a cloud about 1 kilometer wide and long.
rounds.src: US Geological Survey, How much does a cloud weigh?
rounds.fun: That puffy cloud weighs 550 tons, about 1.1 million pounds. Look up!
